verdict.rationale: ByteAsk autonomously edits files, compiles, runs tests and sanitizers, and presents a diff for review (byteask-docs-1, byteask-docs-18). Its headless `exec` mode runs a task to completion with workspace-write sandboxing and JSON output, so it can run unattended in CI pipelines (byteask-docs-4, byteask-docs-19, byteask-docs-20, byteask-docs-5). However, it is documented as a terminal-local agent rather than a hosted cloud agent, and nothing shows it producing a demo of the finished feature. Missing for 10: a first-party cloud/remote agent execution environment, demo artifacts (screenshots, recordings or preview deployments) for review, and independent corroboration of end-to-end autonomous feature delivery.
